answer_2.quote: Following Zhong et al. (2023), we evaluate model performance using Multi-hop Accuracy (MAcc) and Hop-wise Answering Accuracy (H-Acc). MAcc measures the accuracy of multi-hop question answering, while H-Acc assesses correctness at each reasoning step. For both metrics, we consider a prediction correct if the ground-truth answer appears in the generated text as Cohen et al. (2024); Zhong et al. (2023) did.
